# Handwriting attribution

`hand-font.ts` contains normalized stroke data derived from EMS Allure.

- EMS Allure: Sheldon B. Michaels.
- SVG conversion: Windell H. Oskay.
- Original Allura design: Rob Leuschke / TypeSETit.
- Source: https://gitlab.com/oskay/svg-fonts/-/raw/master/fonts/EMS/EMSAllure.svg
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1. See the adjacent OFL.txt for the original Allura copyright and complete terms.

The source font name and attribution are retained as provenance; the data is embedded in the library rather than sold as a standalone font.
